concept.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: polished in-game concept screenshot for a real mobile and tablet pinball adventure named FULL TILT. Wide landscape 1536 by 1024. Full viewport top-down celestial pinball playfield in vast midnight navy deep space, subtle teal nebula clouds, stars and warm cosmic dust. Camera close enough to see details, showing one wide open region of a larger connected cosmic world. Playfield fills the screen with no cabinet, browser, device, perspective trapezoid, or enclosing rectangular table. A luminous textured icy cyan planet at left, a smaller amber Saturn with tilted brass rings at upper right, three charcoal asteroids around the central routes and one violet planet toward right. Thin champagne-brass rails bend organically across the scene like orbital arcs, with gaps and junctions opening into distant sectors. White marble ball with short pale cyan comet trail in the center-right near an asteroid. Each planet emits restrained curved cyan gravity-flow arcs around it. Two pairs of slender ivory flippers at bottom-center and far right inside local catch basins, functional pinball lanes with sparse glowing gold targets. Spacious dark areas between objects. Realistic illustrated planet assets, cinematic painterly materials, premium elegant restraint. Sparse native-looking HUD along top in small legible sans-serif type: top left 'FULL TILT', below it 'Launch Basin'; center score '0'; near top right '3 hearts'; two discreet controls 'Map' and 'Pause'. Bottom: wide transparent touch area on left with a thin brass outline and a single slim flipper icon; symmetric touch area right. Center two small native outlined buttons 'PULSE' and 'LAUNCH'. Use warm ivory text, muted blue-gray secondary text, brass lines, muted teal glows. Clean compact UI directly overlaying space, no panels filled with descriptions, no menus covering gameplay. Make the pinball physics layout legible and spectacular, a vast celestial adventure that scrolls with the ball.

processing: PNG to WebP encoding only. No art edits.
